notes: Background: mid-market ecommerce platform (marketplace + direct storefronts). Heavy ticket volume around order issues, returns, fraud disputes.
Primary ask: short, consistent ticket/email summarization + 1-3 suggested auto-tags to attach to Zendesk macros. Wants reliable summarization across noisy threads.
Latency/throughput expectations: 95th percentile < 300ms for single-ticket assistant calls; bulk nightly auto-tagging run must process ~120k messages in under 4 hours.
Cost sensitivity: wants cost per 1k messages under $8 for nightly batch; willing to pay margin for sub-300ms interactive latency.
Model preferences: prefers open models, will accept quantized variants for batch runs. Interested in Redwood recommendations for quantization profiles.
Routing/fallback: needs region-aware routing (NA primary, EU data residency for EU customers). Must fallback to smaller LLM for spikes but keep tag accuracy >85%.
Security: SSO/SAML for console, KMS for keys, audit logs for every inference. Data retention policy: 30 days for transient logs, 7 years for audit events (legal).
Quote from Head of CX (M. Alvarez): 'If the summarization degrades during sale spikes we will revert to manual triage — reliability is non-negotiable.'
POC scope agreed: 2-week POC, integrate with staging Zendesk, run synthetic spike (5x baseline) and nightly batch of last 6 months of tickets (~120k).
Tie-ins: wants macros auto-suggest with confidence score and sample rationale for agent review. Also needs automated tag-to-workflow mapping suggestions.
Internal notes: prefer Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching + cache for nightly jobs. Consider Dedicated for predictable throughput if POC passes.
Legal & procurement: running a standard security questionnaire; procurement expects decision after POC + security sign-off.
